Introduction
This document lists the equipment inspection I1, to be performed on
an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title 
block.
A group of relays operate when the receives a 
 signal from the protection system to initiate the five fighting system and 
 starting it. These relays con also operate when we push the 
manual push button. When these relays operate they start the five fighting pump 
 and opening the electric five valves.
